frozen_candidate_root_contribution: Firm, weighted anchoring — the condition or act of being made to settle immovably in place by being grounded/moored to a fixed point, so that the thing neither drifts, sways, nor moves off its position.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: Firm, weighted anchoring — the condition or act of being made to settle immovably in place by being grounded/moored to a fixed point, so that the thing neither drifts, sways, nor moves off its position.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 14 occurrences the root contributes one thing: fixedness-by-anchoring. (1) The dominant cluster is the plural participle رَوَاسِيَ / رَوَاسِيْ "firmly-anchored ones" = mountains, used 9 times (13:3, 15:19, 16:15, 21:31, 27:61, 31:10, 41:10, 50:7, 77:27). Their function is spelled out repeatedly: they are cast/placed "into the earth" أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ — "lest it sway with you" (16:15, 21:31, 31:10). The residue here is not merely "big rock" but "the anchoring element that holds the earth immovable." (2) 34:13 رَّاسِيَاتٍ describes cauldrons that are fixed/immovable in place (too heavy to be moved), the same fixedness applied to a different object. (3) 79:32 the causative verb أَرْسَاهَا "He anchored them" (the mountains) — the verbal expression of the same firm-fixing act. (4) The verbal-noun cluster مُرْسَىٰ (form IV, N(IV)): in 11:41 the ship's بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا contrasts "its running/coursing" (مجرى) with "its mooring/coming-to-rest" (مرسى) — the point/act at which a moving vessel is brought to firm rest. In 79:42 and 7:187 مُرْسَاهَا asks of the Hour "when is its mursā" — its coming-to-its-fixed-appointed-settling, i.e. its being brought to its determinate, unmovable point of realization. In every case what rsw supplies is the same abstract core: coming/being brought to a firmly-fixed, non-drifting settledness anchored to a point.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Subtracted layers: (a) FORM — N participle رواسٍ/راسيات = "the firmly-anchored one(s)" (agentive/stative reading of the residue); N(IV) verbal noun مُرْسَى = "the point/act of anchoring"; V form-IV أرسى = causative "caused to be anchored." Removing these leaves the bare notion of firm fixedness, independent of whether it is agent, event, or causation. (b) CONSTRUCTION — locative فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ / أَلْقَى فِيهَا (spatial grounding "into"), purposive أَنْ تَمِيدَ ("lest it sway"), and temporal interrogative أَيَّانَ ("when") supply the spatial-vs-temporal and purpose framing; these are frame, not root. (c) PARTICIPANTS — mountains, cauldrons, ship, the Hour differ, but the anchoring residue is constant. (d) CONTEXT — cosmological creation (mountains), the Noah ark narrative (ship), and eschatology (the Hour) differ; stripping context leaves "firmly-fixed settledness anchored to a point."
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 79:42:5:1 (= 7:187:5:1) مُرْسَىٰهَا applied to the Hour. This is the only clearly non-spatial occurrence: the Hour cannot be physically "moored." It reconciles through an internally-attested bridge: the very same form N(IV) مُرْسَى in 11:41 denotes a ship's coming-to-rest/mooring point, explicitly paired against its motion (مجرى "running"). Extending that, the Hour's مرسى is its being brought to its fixed, appointed point of settled realization — the moment at which the presently "running/pending" event is anchored to its determinate arrival. The fixedness-to-a-determinate-point residue is thus recoverable, though via metaphorical (spatial→temporal) extension.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Strongest alternative: the root means merely "stability / rest / settledness" (i.e. the same field as qrr قرر or skn سكن) rather than specifically anchoring. Internal evidence arbitrates against this: 27:61 uses both roots in one verse — جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا ("a resting-place," qrr) AND وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ (rsw). The text treats قرار and رواسي as distinct contributions, so rsw is not generic "rest"; it is the specific grounding/anchoring agent that produces stability, distinguished by the downward-weighted mooring dimension (mountains "cast into" the earth, a ship's anchor, the settling to a fixed point). This favors "firm weighted anchoring" over bare "rest/stability."
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest semantic neighbors: qrr (قرر, settledness / resting-place / permanence), skn (سكن, stillness / dwelling), θbt (ثبت, being firm / steadfast / established), and wtd (وتد, pegging — cf. mountains as أوتاد, 78:7). rsw is distinct in that its fixedness is achieved by weighted grounding/mooring to a point — an anchor sunk, a mountain rooted "into" the earth, a ship brought to its berth, an event fixed to its appointed moment. It foregrounds resistance to drift/sway (تميد) via downward attachment, whereas qrr foregrounds the resting-state itself, skn foregrounds cessation of motion/dwelling, and θbt foregrounds firmness/steadfastness without the mooring/grounding image. Falsifiability: if any rsw occurrence denoted stillness, quiet, or temporary stopping WITHOUT the grounded-anchoring/fixed-to-a-point component (e.g. mere rest or dwelling interchangeable with skn/qrr), the "weighted anchoring" residue would be falsified.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — "firm weighted anchoring / being brought to immovable fixedness at a point" — is recoverable across all 14 occurrences, and internal evidence (27:61 distinguishing قرار from رواسي) sharply separates it from the generic rest/stability field, giving the direction and distinctiveness needed for PREFERRED. Strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG because, while 12 occurrences (mountains رواسي/راسيات ×10 and the causative أرسى, plus the ship's مرسى) are surface-recoverable spatial anchoring, the 2 eschatological cases (7:187, 79:42) require a spatial→temporal metaphorical extension. That extension is not free-floating: it is anchored by an internally-attested bridge — the identical form مُرْسَى used of a physical ship's mooring in 11:41 — so the unity holds without forcing. No occurrence is contradicted; the residue is genuinely present in every one; hence PREFERRED with honest acknowledgment of the metaphorical inference for the Hour.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial sweep of all 14 found no occurrence where fixedness-by-anchoring is genuinely absent or contradicted. Cluster A (9x رَوَاسِيَ mountains) is the candidate's strongest ground: cast/thrown/placed فِى الأرض, with the function spelled out three times as أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ ("lest it sway with you"). 27:61 even lexically separates قَرَارًا (resting-place) from رَوَاسِيَ (anchoring element), which sharpens the candidate rather than diluting it. 34:13 رَّاسِيَاتٍ (immovable cauldrons) and 79:32 أَرْسَاهَا (causative "anchored the mountains") are straightforward. HARDEST CASE: the N(IV) مُرْسَىٰ cluster. 11:41 (ship's mooring, contrasted with مجراها "coursing") is a clean spatial fit. The Hour's مُرْسَاهَا (79:42, 7:187) is the real pressure point, because the frozen candidate's wording is aggressively spatial-physical ("immovably IN PLACE," "neither drifts, sways, nor moves off its position," "weighted") and a temporal event does not literally sway/drift. I attempted to break this into a spatial-vs-temporal split (homonymy), but it fails as a refutation: (1) identical morphology carries both ship-mooring and Hour; (2) the bridge "brought to a determinate fixed point" is a standard non-ad-hoc lexical extension (classical: وقت ثبوتها/وقوعها); (3) 7:187 itself supplies the weight resonance the candidate relies on — ثَقُلَتْ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ. The abstract residue (fixedness-by-anchoring-to-a-determinate-point) is present in all 14. Distinctiveness holds against nearest neighbors: ثبت (generic firmness), رسخ (deep-rootedness), قرّ (rest — appears as a distinct lexeme قرار in 27:61); rsw is specifically the anchoring element/act producing fixedness by grounding-into or mooring-to a point. Falsifiable via a clear failure condition (any sense of flow/growth/motion lacking fixedness); none met. Only genuine weakness is mild OVER-SPECIFICATION in the candidate's phrasing ("weighted," "in place") relative to the temporal Hour cases, requiring a spatial→temporal reading of "point" — but this is imprecise wording, not a semantic failure of any occurrence, so the unity stands as SUPPORTED.
